newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Avon to invest $34 mln in Philippines.
newsitem.headline: Avon to invest $34 mln in Philippines.

text.p: Avon Products Inc plans to invest $34 million to put up a manufacturing plant in the Philippines, a statement from the Philippine Presidential Palace said on Saturday.
Avon chairman James Preston told President Fidel Ramos that Avon plans to invest $34 million in a new manufacturing and distribution facility near Manila, the statement said.
Construction of the new manufacturing plant will start in January 1997 and is scheduled to be completed in 1998.
Preston said the new facility will be used as the supply base of the cosmetics and fashion jewelry distributor to Malaysia, Taiwan, Australia and India, Malacanang added.
Other details of Avon's proposed investment were not given.
